dedupe_keys.name: global cement and concrete tracker gcct

description: The Global Cement and Concrete Tracker from Global Energy Monitor lists integrated, grinding and clinker-only cement plants worldwide, including plants proposed or under construction since 2018 and retired or mothballed since 2021. On 26 September 2026 it counted 3,884 plants in 171 countries and areas with 6.1 billion tonnes of annual cement capacity and 3.7 billion tonnes of clinker capacity. For each plant it gives location, ownership, operating status, annual clinker and cement capacity, existing and planned kiln numbers, plant-level production and production methods, including green cement technologies, and a GEM.wiki page with sources. The latest release was July 2026 and data are updated annually. Access is a free tracker map, dashboard and summary tables, and a spreadsheet after a download request form, under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: historic capacity of units retired inside operating plants before the stated dates is not captured, and production is reported only where disclosed. For simulation it is an asset inventory of cement plants, which are large energy consumers and suppliers to construction, for supply-chain, hazard exposure and decarbonisation studies. Related catalogue records include the SFI GeoAsset cement database, Climate TRACE and the Global Iron and Steel Tracker.
